# Interior Design Expert Skill for Muse

Professional-grade interior design expertise: Munsell color science with metamerism warnings, IES-standard lighting design (layered ambient/task/accent, lux levels per room, color temperature by time of day), space planning with circulation minimums and furniture clearances, style reference across Mid-Century, Scandinavian, Japandi, and Maximalist, plus structured AI visualization prompts with negative prompts for photorealistic room renders. Anti-patterns are called out explicitly — blocking traffic flow, single-source lighting, scale mismatch, paint chosen from memory. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the AI visualization workflow points at Stability AI / Ideogram MCPs whose API keys are optional, possibly paid extras — the design knowledge, calculations, and prompt structures are fully usable without them. Also explicitly out of scope: structural changes, building codes/permits, and exterior design. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
